entries.summary: Wave 1 guarantees touch and pen drag interaction on the browser host. Mouse drag is left as an explicit follow-up instead of being overclaimed in the first SwipeView parity slice.
Mirage maps SwipeTransitionMode to deterministic browser Reveal and Drag approximations on the DOM host, but exact native platform transition visuals and physics remain browser-limited in Wave 1.
Wave 1 proves generic single-content SwipeView plus CollectionView-row embedding through a dedicated parity probe instead of claiming the full upstream SwipeView gallery set is unblocked already.
